page_title: WHU 0-0 EVE | West Ham v Everton 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' It will be a corner kick for West Ham.
90+4' Danny Ings (West Ham) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top left corner, but Jordan Pickford makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
90+2' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sees a yellow card from Stuart Attwell after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
86' Sean Dyche has decided to make a change. Jack Harrison (Everton) replaces Abdoulaye Doucoure.
86' Julen Lopetegui is stunned as referee Stuart Attwell shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
85' The foul by Ashley Young (Everton) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Stuart Attwell.
83' It's time for a substitution. Luis Guilherme (West Ham) comes on in place of Crysencio Summerville.
82' The resulting corner from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is cleared by the defence.
81' West Ham have a corner.
80' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
79' The ball is out of play. Everton will have a throw-in.
76' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Stuart Attwell had an easy-decision to make.
75' Sean Dyche prepares a substitution. Dominic Calvert-Lewin is replaced by Beto (Everton).
74' OFF THE POST! Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
72' A pass from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is intercepted by Jordan Pickford and the move breaks down.
69' The ball is behind the touchline and West Ham will take a throw-in.
67' Substitution. Michail Antonio makes way for Danny Ings (West Ham).
67' Julen Lopetegui has decided to substitute Aaron Wan-Bissaka and he is replaced by Vladimir Coufal (West Ham).
67' Here comes a substitution. Guido Rodriguez is given a rest as he is replaced by Carlos Soler (West Ham).
66' Everton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
64' Ashley Young (Everton) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

63' What a chance that is! Orel Mangala (Everton) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
62' Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
60' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Everton.
60' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
59' The ball is out of play. Everton will take a throw-in.
57' A snap shot by Guido Rodriguez (West Ham) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Jordan Pickford produces a good save to thwart him.
55' Looks like Ashley Young (Everton) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
54' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Everton.
53' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
51' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) leaps like a salmon to meet a lofted ball into the box, but his header from near the penalty spot fizzes narrowly wide of the right post.
49' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to West Ham.
49' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the left post.
48' Surely that's handball by one of the West Ham players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
47' Everton take a short corner kick.
47' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Jesper Lindstrom (Everton), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. Everton force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from West Ham comes to nothing.

45+1' Jordan Pickford was forced into action to thwart Michail Antonio (West Ham). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

44' Jordan Pickford pulls off a great save to deny Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
43' Ashley Young (Everton) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
41' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Lukasz Fabianski is prepared to thwart his effort.
39' The ball has crossed the sideline. Everton are taking a throw-in.
37' Emerson (West Ham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
33' The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
31' West Ham are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
29' The ball is out of play. Everton will have a chance to score from a corner.
28' It's a throw-in for Everton.
25' 0:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.

23' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Iliman Ndiaye (Everton), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.

22' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.

21' The game is interrupted. Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. West Ham win a free kick.
20' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for West Ham.
18' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
17' Michail Antonio (West Ham) commits a foul and Stuart Attwell immediately signals a free kick.

15' So close! Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.
14' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) commits a rough foul. Stuart Attwell stops the game and makes a call. Everton win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.

12' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) was close to scoring after a great solo effort and unleashed a promising shot from the edge of the penalty area. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Lukasz Fabianski showed his agility and saved this one.
9' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
9' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
8' Emerson (West Ham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
8' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
6' Referee Stuart Attwell sees the trip by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to West Ham in a dangerous position.

4' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
2' That's a free kick to West Ham. A player from Everton commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
West Ham will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Stuart Attwell.
